The '''2021 Copa Sudamericana final stages''' was played from 13 July to 20 November 2021.<ref name="calendar">{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/calendario_2021_02_10_2020.pdf|title=CALENDÁRIO 2021: CONMEBOL Libertadores - CONMEBOL Sudamericana - RECOPA|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=2 October 2020}}</ref> A total of 16 teams competed in the final stages to decide the champions of the [[2021 Copa Sudamericana]],<ref name="regulations">{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/reglamento-sudamericana-manual-de-clubes-2021-es.pdf|title=Manual de Clubes / Reglamento CONMEBOL Sudamericana 2021|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|language=es}}</ref> with the final played in [[Montevideo]], [[Uruguay]] at [[Estadio Centenario]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/es/montevideo-sera-la-sede-de-las-finales-unicas-de-la-conmebol|title=Montevideo será la sede de las finales únicas de la CONMEBOL|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=13 May 2021|language=es}}</ref>

==Qualified teams==
The winners of each of the eight groups in the [[2021 Copa Sudamericana group stage|Copa Sudamericana group stage]] as well as the third-placed teams of each of the eight groups in the [[2021 Copa Libertadores group stage|Copa Libertadores group stage]] advanced to the round of 16.

==Format==
<section begin=Format />
Starting from the round of 16, the teams play a [[single-elimination tournament]] with the following rules:<ref name="regulations"/>
*In the round of 16, quarter-finals and semi-finals, each tie is played on a home-and-away [[two-legged tie|two-legged]] basis, with the higher-seeded team hosting the second leg (Regulations Article 2.2.3). If tied on aggregate, the [[away goals rule]] will be used. If still tied, [[Overtime (sports)#Association football|extra time]] will not be played, and a [[penalty shoot-out (association football)|penalty shoot-out]] will be used to determine the winners (Regulations Article 2.4.4).
*The final is played as a single match at a venue pre-selected by CONMEBOL, with the higher-seeded team designated as the "home" team for administrative purposes (Regulations Article 2.2.6). If tied after regulation, 30 minutes of [[Overtime (sports)#Association football|extra time]] will be played. If still tied after extra time, a [[penalty shoot-out (association football)|penalty shoot-out]] will be used to determine the winners (Regulations Article 2.4.5).<section end=Format />

==Draw==
<section begin=Draw />
The draw for the round of 16 was held on 1 June 2021, 12:00 [[Time in Paraguay|PYT]] ([[UTC−04:00|UTC−4]]), at the CONMEBOL Convention Centre in [[Luque]], [[Paraguay]].<ref name="Final stages draw">{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/es/pautas-del-sorteo-de-octavos-de-final-de-la-conmebol-sudamericana-2021 |title=Pautas del sorteo de Octavos de Final de la CONMEBOL Sudamericana 2021|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=28 May 2021|language=es}}</ref> For the round of 16, the 16 teams were drawn into eight ties (A–H) between a Copa Sudamericana group winner (Pot 1) and a Copa Libertadores group third-placed (Pot 2), with the Copa Sudamericana group winners hosting the second leg. Teams from the same association or the same group could be drawn into the same tie (Regulations Article 2.2.3.2).<ref name="regulations"/><section end=Draw />
